Review follow-up of #32445 PR 2 (PR #32816, contract review records 6836017834 and the PASS on `199aa958`). Nits from that review, filed instead of a rework round.

Filing gate: ② review nits (review-checklist: small findings go to a follow-up card under the source card). class: b · type: Hardening · Suggested-grade: p2 · lane: `domain:server` (triage to confirm).

Blocked-by: #32816

## Do

- **N1 — the answer counts what was sent.** `POST /api/v1/messaging/in-app-messages` answers a recipient count that includes enqueues that failed. When the member lookup fails or no inbox channel is available, it still answers `200` with 0 recipients and the console says "Message sent". Count only accepted deliveries; answer an error (or a distinct status) when nothing was enqueued.
- **N2 — bound a single recipient id.** Title, body, link and recipient count are bounded; one recipient id is not, and it is echoed in the non-member refusal. Add a per-id length bound (the request-body limit caps it today).
- **N3 — a send rate.** No per-organization send-rate limit exists (the ruling did not ask for one). Decide a sane default or record why none.
- **N4 — an API-key pin on this door.** The credential census pins the shared caller module through the preference-options door only. Add a test that drives the in-app door with an API key and asserts the client address it hands on.

Reader who acts: `packages/services/service-messaging/src/in-app-message-routes.ts` and its tests.
